text: Optical engineering is a multidisciplinary field that is based on the properties and propagation laws of light, as well as the interaction between light and matter, and combines engineering technology to achieve the generation, regulation, detection, and application of light. It covers various fields ranging from basic optical theory to the development of optoelectronic devices, optical system design, and laser technology applications. It is an important support for the development of modern information technology, intelligent manufacturing, biomedicine, and other industries.
